sentences.en: A custom developed in which they would kiss each other.
sentences.zh: 他们之间形成了一种亲吻对方的习惯。

sentences.en: His depression came to an end when she kissed him.
sentences.zh: 当她吻他的时候，他的抑郁结束了。

sentences.en: Even though we're engaged, she wouldn't let me kiss her.
sentences.zh: 即使我们已经订婚了，她也不让我吻她。
